A healthy, resilient society is built on:

  • Upholding the Rule of Law Equally: Ensuring that all citizens are subject to the same laws and protections, judged as individuals based on their actions, not their identity or faith.

The premise that Islam should be outlawed and Muslims forced to renounce their faith is not only morally reprehensible and a violation of the most fundamental human rights, but it is also strategically disastrous for social cohesion. It is based on dangerous generalizations, historical ignorance, and a fundamental misunderstanding of how free and democratic societies function. Protecting the religious freedom of all citizens, including Muslims, is not a weakness; it is the bedrock of a just, stable, and truly unified society.
